article.story: NATCHITOCHES, La. -- — Andrew Holifield scored 22 points to lead Lamar to a 75-65 victory over Northwestern State on Monday night. Holifield went 8 of 11 from the field (5 for 6 from 3-point range) for the Cardinals (17-10, 12-4 Southland Conference). Alexis Marmolejos hit three 3-pointers and scored 13. Danquez Dawsey hit two 3-pointers and scored 13. Micah Thomas finished with 16 points to lead the Demons (12-15, 8-8). Willie Williams added 15 points and six rebounds. Addison Patterson pitched in with 14 points, six rebounds and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
